theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_tg_cc_contDiff_range_chart_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (n P : ℕ) (G : Eucl n → Eucl P), ContDiff ℝ 1 G → ∃ O : ℕ → Set (Eucl n), (∀ k, IsOpen (O k)) ∧ (∀ k, ∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith K G (O k)) ∧ (∀ k, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ O k, ∀ w' ∈ O k, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖G w - G w'‖) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) (range G \ ⋃ k, G '' O k) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
